content:
Maya S: Quick sync 2 webinar launch posts + inbound routing. Need an SEO preflight checklist before publish: keywords, JSON-LD, internal links, redirects. Were aiming to go live next Tue.

Ravi K: Locking keywords first. Propose three primaries and a handful of longtails. Also confirm canonical tags and meta descriptions.

Maya S: Primaries: "LLM inference platform", "production LLM serving", "dedicated inference clusters". Longtails: inference cost optimization, KV cache, model rollouts, batching strategies.

Tara L: Ill author minimal JSON-LD blocks: WebPage + Event + FAQ. Drop sample Event JSON-LD in the head. Will add 3 FAQ Q/As from the webinar script.

Devon P: Redirect plan: Ill map old URLs to the new landing and run a 301 sweep night of publish. CSV template: source,target,code with a few lines.

Ravi K: Internal linking task: add CTAs from /docs/runtime and /product/features to the landing. Anchors: "Low-latency serving", "Dedicated capacity", "Reduce inference cost". Ill open the PRs.

Maya S: Inbound routing: include utm params + webinar_id in CRM webhook. Rule: company_size > 50 -> SDR; else -> nurture. Add "interested_in" attribute. @Devon confirm payload fields.

Devon P: Confirmed. Webhook includes email, first_name, last_name, company, company_size (number), utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, webinar_id. Returns 200 OK on success.

Tara L: Messaging A/B hero variants for modal:
A) "Ship LLM features with predictable latency"
B) "Cut inference cost while keeping SLAs"
Run 50/50 for first 1k impressions, measure CTR + signups.

Maya S: Timeline: blog draft by Fri (1712430000), landing live Tue (1712489999), redirect sweep Tue night. Owners: Tara (schema & copy), Devon (redirects & webhooks), Ravi (internal links), Maya (PM).

SEO-bot: Task created 2 MARKETING-4122 2 webinar landing SEO + redirects (https://trello.company/board/card/MARKETING-4122).

Maya S: I'll post the draft here when ready. Any blockers?

Ravi K: None from Eng. :thumbsup:
